title: 第二十六章 顺线揪余孽，旧宗秘事浮
content_zh:
夜色深浓，相府行刑偏院灯火通明。

    苏文被铁链锁在石柱之上，遍身禁锢，依旧牙关紧咬，眼底是死忠到底的执拗，任凭几番审讯，半分核心秘辛都不肯吐露。

    暗卫躬身回禀：“王爷，大小姐，此人骨硬志坚，受过暗阁禁魂训，宁死不叛宗门，常规审讯无用。但属下顺着他近日行踪排查，锁定了西郊废弃荒院，是京城暗阁探子的临时落脚点。”

    萧聿辞眸光微沉，即刻下令：“连夜围堵，不留活口、不留痕迹，尽数清缴，搜遍所有密卷信物。”

    “是！”

    一众精锐暗卫连夜策马出城，趁着沉沉夜色直奔西郊。

    汀兰院内，沈清鸢静坐窗前，心底思绪翻涌。

    结合柳氏遗言、玉佩秘纹、老夫人的只言片语，再加上苏文登门逼要血脉，她已然拼凑出七八分真相。

    母亲的隐世宗族、特殊血脉、百年暗阁，这三者本就是一体。

    只是她始终想不通，护宗之人，为何会沦为祸乱世间、残害人命的邪逆势力？

    不过半柱香时辰，西郊捷报传回。

    暗卫清缴据点大获全胜，斩杀潜伏探子十余人，搜出一箱封存密卷、往来信札与宗门旧册，尽数带回相府。

    案前烛火摇曳，泛黄陈旧的卷宗层层铺开。

    纸张历经岁月磨损，字迹潦草隐秘，皆是暗阁内部私记，无人知晓、无人查阅，今日终于重见天日。

    沈清鸢指尖轻轻拂过纸面，一字一句细读，尘封数十年的终极秘辛，缓缓浮出水面。

    百年之前，世间隐世宗族林立，她的母族【清玄宗】为首，世代守护世间秘脉与天地信物，与世无争、从不涉朝堂江湖纷争。

    而暗阁，最初本是清玄宗护宗卫队，世代忠诚，守护宗族圣女血脉、镇守秘宝信物。

    百年安稳，人心异变。

    数十年前，暗阁新任主事野心暴涨，不甘困于隐世山林，妄图借圣女独特血脉，催动宗族秘力、掌控天下暗势，借此插手朝堂更迭、掌控世间棋局。

    当代圣女，正是她的生母。

    生母生性温柔通透，厌弃纷争杀戮，不愿沦为野心棋子，更不愿让宗族秘力落入恶人之手、祸乱苍生。

    恰逢暗阁逼婚逼权，强行逼迫圣女献祭血脉、开启秘宝。
content_en:
The night was dark, and the execution wing of the Prime Minister's Mansion was brightly lit.

Su Wen was chained to a stone pillar, imprisoned all over his body, and his teeth were still clenched. There was a stubbornness in his eyes that was loyal to the end. Despite several interrogations, he refused to reveal even half of his core secrets.

The secret guard bowed and reported back: "Your Majesty, eldest lady, this man is strong-willed and strong-willed. He has received the soul-forbidden training of the Dark Pavilion. He would rather die than betray the sect. Regular interrogation is useless. However, my subordinates followed his recent whereabouts and located the abandoned courtyard in the western suburbs. It is the temporary foothold of the secret pavilion spies in the capital."

Xiao Yuci's eyes darkened slightly, and he immediately ordered: "Surround them all night long, leaving no survivors or traces, confiscate them all, and search for all secret documents and tokens."

"Yes!"

A group of elite secret guards rode out of the city overnight, taking advantage of the dark night to head straight to the western suburbs.

In Tinglan Courtyard, Shen Qingyuan sat quietly in front of the window, thoughts swirling in her heart.

Combining Liu's last words, the secret pattern of the jade pendant, the old lady's words, and Su Wen's visit to demand blood, she has pieced together the truth.

Mother's hidden clan, special bloodline, and century-old secret pavilion, these three are one.

It's just that she still can't figure out why the people who protect the sect become an evil and rebellious force that brings trouble to the world and kills people.

Within half an hour of the incense stick, the good news came back from the western suburbs.

The secret guard cleared the stronghold and achieved a complete victory. They killed more than ten lurking spies, found a box of sealed secret volumes, correspondence and old sect books, and brought them all back to the Prime Minister's Mansion.

The candlelight flickered in front of the case, and yellowed and old files were laid out layer by layer.

The paper has been worn by the years, and the handwriting is scrawled and cryptic. They are all private notes inside the secret cabinet. No one knows or consults them. Today, they are finally seen again.

Shen Qingyuan's fingertips lightly brushed the paper, reading each word carefully, and the ultimate secret that had been sealed for decades slowly surfaced.

A hundred years ago, there were many hidden clans in the world, headed by her maternal clan [Qing Xuanzong], who had guarded the secrets of the world and the tokens of heaven and earth for generations. They had no disputes with the world and never got involved in the disputes in the court.

The Dark Pavilion was originally the Qing Xuan Sect's sect-protecting bodyguard. They were loyal for generations, guarding the bloodline of the clan's saints and guarding the secret treasure tokens.

After a hundred years of stability, people's hearts have changed.

Decades ago, the ambition of the new head of the Dark Pavilion skyrocketed, and he was unwilling to be trapped in the mountains and forests. He tried to use the unique blood of the saint to activate the secret power of the clan and control the world's dark forces, so as to intervene in the changes in the court and control the world's chess game.

The contemporary saint is her biological mother.

The biological mother is gentle and transparent by nature, she hates strife and killing, she doesn't want to become a pawn of ambition, and she doesn't want the secret power of the family to fall into the hands of evil people and bring disaster to the common people.

It happened that the secret court was forcing marriage and power, forcing the saint to sacrifice her blood and unlock the secret treasure.
